doc.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024

title: Bob Mintzer's advice to title a piece first
summary: Davis recalls composition lessons with Mintzer and his advice to title a song before writing.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Bob Mintzer told me once, I took some lessons from him before I was in his band, for composition and arranging. And Bob said, “You know before you start it title your song.” And it was really an interesting thought. I don’t always do it, sometimes I do it after it’s done and has a vibe that I think works. But I thought that was a cool thing to say because then that gives you a direction at least that you’re going to go musically, what’s the style of this you know. So that’s another thing that can be done.
